metadata.description: ContentStudio social-media automation skill — scheduling and social inbox across 10+ platforms

plugins.name: contentstudio
plugins.description: Social-media automation CLI for scheduling posts and managing the social inbox (DMs, comments, reviews), media, accounts, and approvals across Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Pinterest, Threads, Tumblr, Bluesky, and Google Business Profile via the ContentStudio API.
